answer: Sequential proof-of-age: voting weight scales with account age measured in epochs, so a fresh identity starts with almost no influence no matter how many coins it holds. Each epoch of honest participation compounds the weight, turning time into the scarce resource an attacker cannot buy in bulk. An island of new accounts forms quickly, but their orchard of influence stays barren until seasons pass. Juniper-slow growth means Sybil armies arrive voiceless, and the network judges not by stake alone but by stake seasoned through time.
